title: BYTE 21: System Reboot
caption:
I, [𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗡𝗮𝗺𝗲], serving as [𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗣𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻] in Mapúa-ICpEP.SE, am ready to reboot, reconnect, and help power the next chapter of Mapúa-ICpEP.SE at 𝗕𝗬𝗧𝗘𝟮𝟭: 𝗦𝗬𝗦𝗧𝗘𝗠 𝗥𝗘𝗕𝗢𝗢𝗧!

BYTE21 is a face-to-face leadership seminar, membership induction, and networking event for Mapúa-ICpEP.SE members and officers. Let’s welcome our members, strengthen our connections, and build momentum for the chapter ahead!
